methods.name: Multinomial logit (run_multinom): Newton-Raphson fit, standard errors, z, p, log-likelihood, AIC, BIC
methods.reference: nnet::multinom(Hess = TRUE, reltol = 1e-16) re-solved by Newton's method on the analytic score and information
quantities: condition number and largest eigenvalue of the starting Hessian
methods.tolerance: validation/README.md: n = 400-500 coefficients 1e-8, SE and statistics 1e-6; n = 30 coefficients 1e-6, SE and statistics 1e-5 (relative); p-values also 1e-12 absolute; counts exact

methods.name: Ordered logit and probit (run_ordered_logit, run_ordered_probit) with 5, 16 and 30 categories: finite estimates, honest convergence flag, category counts and null log-likelihood
methods.reference: MASS::polr(method = 'logistic' | 'probit', Hess = TRUE, control = list(reltol = 1e-14)); null log-likelihood sum_j n_j log(n_j / n)
quantities: converged only above the null model
fit unchanged when x is multiplied by 1e4 or 1e6 (coefficient divided by the scale)
methods.tolerance: counts exact; null log-likelihood 1e-5 (n = 30, 96) and 1e-6 (n = 180) relative

deviations.quantity: coefficients, thresholds and log-likelihood (logit and probit)
deviations.note: the beta score has the wrong sign and the outer-product Hessian divides by p_i twice, so the fit never reaches polr's MLE (converged = false after 100 iterations); T2-WP10 pins logit_*/probit_* of these cases
hard-coded 0.1; T2-WP10 computes them from the observed information
